newsitem.title: USA: Petroleum Heat extends expiry dates.
newsitem.headline: Petroleum Heat extends expiry dates.

text.p: Petroleum Heat & Power Inc on Monday said it extended until January 10, 1997, the expiration date of the consent solicitation to holders of its 12-1/4 percent subordinated debentures due 2005.
The company said it had also extended to the same date the expiration of its 9-3/8 percent subordinated debentures due 2006.
The consent solicitation for those due 2005 had been scheduled to expire December 30, it said.
The company said it was soliciting consents in order to refinance $82.9 million of preferred stock, of which $72.5 million is maturing over the next two years.
It said it also needed the funds to cover the costs and fees associated with the refinancing.
Petroleum Heat and Power Co Inc is a retail distributor of home heating oil in the United States, serving about 400,000 customers in the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic states.
